source: GBIF occurrence search + PRESERVED_SPECIMEN pass, retrieved 2026-08-24
comment: Per-species ecoregion membership derived from georeferenced occurrence records by scripts/seed_ecoregion_ranges.py. Keyed by scientific name because plant ids are not stable across a reseed. Geographic ecoregions only — riparian and wet_meadow are site-scale moisture niches and are not derivable from a coordinate. A record counts for a region only where it lies more than 900 m inside it, which is the outlines' own positional accuracy: nearer than that, which side of the line a record falls on is not something this data can settle, so it counts for no region rather than for a guess.
